audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Darius Levels 1, 2, 4-5, first item and two-plus items, while every matching 'why' in the same entry says the opposite — whys[0] and whys[1] describe being poked and zoned, whys[3] calls 4-5 a coinflip, whys[5] calls first item even, whys[6] hands late back to Heimerdinger.
audit.why: Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units and the turret is a 1-second-cooldown deployable, so pre-Apprehend Darius cannot answer anything. The lane only opens at 3 and at 6. Emerald+ win rate is 47.69% over 889 games, which agrees with Heimerdinger owning more stages than Darius.
audit.corrected: Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Darius / Skill / Darius / Skill / Heimerdinger in both layers.
sources: internal contradiction with whys[0], whys[1], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 stage text is the LaTeX fragment 'R = d + a \times Stacks', and the first-item stage says 'Force fights on CH-2 Grenade (Stun)'s cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11 seconds and UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70 — those are the two clocks that decide whether you can cross his zone.
audit.corrected: Plain Level 6 text plus the 11-second grenade window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry calls Hextech Micro-Rockets his Q in five places ('Q Hextech Micro-Rockets', 'Q Micro-Rockets') and refers to firing 'CH-3X' turrets.
audit.why: Q is H-28 G Evolution Turret; Micro-Rockets are W, 1325 range on an 11-second rank-1 cooldown. The grenade is E, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, flat 11 seconds, stunning only a direct hit and slowing everything around it. Nothing named CH-3X exists in Riot's data. The direct-hit condition matters: a grazed grenade only slows you, so a body-blocking minion or a sidestep turns his stun into a slow you can walk through.
audit.corrected: Rockets called W with their range and cooldown; grenade called E with the direct-hit stun versus splash slow distinction; the invented turret name removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry says 'Carry threat: 7.5/10' while carryRating and the report both say 8.5/10.

edits.before: Hemorrhage passive bleed completely overwhelms raw early base stats in any standing fight. Trade on his last-hits but don't chase past the wave.
edits.after: A turret goes down on a 1-second cooldown and Micro-Rockets poke from 1325 units. You have no answer yet — take the safe last-hits and hold your health.

edits.before: Access to Crippling Strike (W) auto-attack reset provides immense localized burst punishes. Hold it for a guaranteed pull; a whiffed Apprehend is a free lane for Heimerdinger.
edits.after: Crippling Strike gives you an auto-attack reset, but you still cannot reach him past the turret line and the rockets. Farm safely — a whiffed Apprehend later is a free lane for Heimerdinger.

edits.before: Full basic kits unlocked on both sides; spacing out displacements determines the winner. Keep the wave near your tower so Heimerdinger has to walk into pull range.
edits.after: Apprehend is online: pull him off the nest and the extended trade is yours. Keep the wave near your tower so Heimerdinger has to walk into pull range.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, so it finishes him through any amount of zone chip. Commit E and W first, then execute — a kill refreshes it.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness — the run-down you couldn't finish before is now lethal. Force fights on CH-2 Grenade (Stun)'s cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness, but it is even at best. Force fights inside the 11-second window after his grenade misses.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: A full nest and upgraded grenade wall you off before you reach him. Flank fights he has not pre-placed; one pull chain still kills.

edits.before: This is your window: with E Apprehend up, walk into his H-28G turret zone, pull him off the wall, and W Crippling Strike him before he can Q Hextech Micro-Rockets you back to the turrets. You take chip from the turrets but a single successful E-pull trade swings the lane — just don't dive into a full three-turret nest.
edits.after: This is your window: with E Apprehend up, walk into his H-28 G turret zone, pull him off the wall, and W Crippling Strike him before W Hextech Micro-Rockets push you back out. You take chip from the turrets but one successful E-pull swings the lane — just don't dive a full three-turret nest.

edits.before: R Noxian Guillotine gives you a way to punish him, but it's skill-dependent — he'll R-upgrade his E Stun Grenade for a long AoE stun and can CH-3X-fire his turrets. Execute only when you've already committed E and W; if you eat the upgraded stun on approach, you die in the turret field instead of him.
edits.after: R Noxian Guillotine gives you a way to punish him, but it's skill-dependent — UPGRADE!!! turns his E grenade into a long AoE stun on a 100-second cooldown. Only a direct hit stuns; the splash just slows. Execute after E and W are committed, or you die in the turret field instead.

edits.before: He tilts back into his favour: a fully built Heimerdinger turret nest plus upgraded R shreds you before you cross it, and his Q Micro-Rockets max-range poke keeps you out of stack range entirely. Don't solo-dive the nest late — force him in teamfights where he can't set up turrets in advance.
edits.after: He tilts back into his favour: a fully built turret nest plus upgraded R shreds you before you cross it, and W Micro-Rockets poke from 1325 units to keep you out of stack range entirely. Don't solo-dive the nest late — force him into fights where he can't pre-place turrets.

edits.before: Wall up turrets and poke with Q Micro-Rockets
edits.after: Wall up turrets and poke with W Micro-Rockets

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are miserable — Heimerdinger drops a turret and pokes you with Q Micro-Rockets while you can't retaliate before E. Farm what you safely can under tower and wait for level 3 to change the math.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are miserable — Heimerdinger re-drops turrets constantly and pokes with W Micro-Rockets from 1325 units while you have no answer before E. Farm what you can under tower and wait for level 3.

edits.before: He drops turrets and pokes with Q Micro-Rockets before you can trade at 1.
edits.after: He drops turrets and pokes with W Micro-Rockets before you can trade.

edits.before: Late, Heimerdinger reasserts control: a full turret nest plus upgraded R stun wall you off before you reach him, and max-range Q poke denies your stacks. Stop diving the nest solo — group and make him fight on your engage instead of his prepared zone.
edits.after: Late, Heimerdinger reasserts control: a full turret nest plus upgraded E stun wall you off before you reach him, and 1325-range W poke denies your stacks. Stop diving the nest solo — group and make him fight on your engage instead of his prepared zone.

edits.before: Carry threat: 7.5/10. If Heimerdinger gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.
edits.after: Carry threat: 8.5/10. If Heimerdinger gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.

notes: The phrase 'CH-3X-fire his turrets' in the old spikes[1] does not correspond to anything in Riot's data for Heimerdinger; I removed it rather than guess what the upgraded turret does. Only a direct grenade hit stuns — that distinction is not in the entry anywhere else and is worth propagating to other Heimerdinger pages.
